company.name: Otrium
company.shortDescription: Otrium is an online fashion outlet marketplace which tech-enables designer brands to turn unsold inventory into an opportunity,
company.description: Otrium has over 300 brand partnerships with both up-and-coming designers and luxury names and more than 3 million shopping members. Otrium is disrupting the fashion industry by solving the problem of unsold inventory using data.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform enabling designer brands to sell unsold inventory directly to consumers through an online outlet store.
productsAndServices.name: Otrium Online Fashion Outlet Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A data-driven approach that uses customer insights to create fashion items that better match demand, reducing unsold inventory and fabric waste.
productsAndServices.name: Data-Made Fashion

productsAndServices.description: Services that prepare unsold or returned fashion items for resale by cleaning, repairing, photographing, and repackaging them.
productsAndServices.name: Inventory Polishing and Refurbishment Services

productsAndServices.description: A customizable online outlet store for fashion brands to sell excess inventory while maintaining control over brand presentation and pricing.
productsAndServices.name: Brand Partner Online Outlet Channel

productsAndServices.description: Tools and data services that help fashion brands track, report, and improve their environmental and social governance related to unsold inventory.
productsAndServices.name: Sustainability and ESG Reporting Support

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $117,273,577, or 76.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,728,325 to $897,273,577, a 519.16x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 57 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
